model.description: vortex-panel-informed neural operator for steady airfoil flow (surface branch)
components: sheet operator: 19-d conditioning vector -> anti-derivative-approximator rate -> effective vortex sheet on a 241-node loop, Kutta condition imposed by a linear projection for every network output (125,634 parameters)
boundary-layer operator: four heads giving momentum and displacement thickness on a 121-node uniform x/c grid per surface (402,948 parameters)
drag closure: frozen degree-2 polynomial in (log theta_TE, H_TE, u_e,TE), ten coefficients, clipped to [1e-4, 0.1]
lift closure: frozen degree-2 polynomial in (C_l^gamma, theta_TE per surface, delta*_TE per surface, u_e,TE), 28 coefficients; the viscous-decambering correction to the circulation lift
readouts from the same sheet: surface pressure on 240 panel midpoints, circulation lift, quarter-chord moment, stagnation point (no stagnation label in the objective), trailing-edge edge velocity

RANS coefficient correction (vortfoil.rans; predict(..., rans=True)): five 5-32-32-3 tanh networks on (C_l, ln C_d, C_m, alpha, log10 Re) of the deployed coefficients, fitted on the 780 AirfRANS training cases against k-omega SST; C_l + f_l, C_d exp(f_d), C_m + f_m

training.sheet: 449,732 filtered XFOIL rows (Ncrit 7, incompressible, 200 panels; UIUC, NACA four-digit and perturbed Kulfan shapes), 400 epochs; loss = surface-pressure MSE + 10x trailing-edge pressure + 10x label-free stagnation self-consistency + 1x direct circulation-lift term
training.closures: both fitted once by ridge regression on the same 325,370 training rows and then frozen; no evaluation row enters either fit

converged_rows.description: 80 held-out UIUC shapes, alpha <= 12 deg, rows passing the validity filter AND whose XFOIL solution converged; the reported population of the paper

all_validity_filtered_rows.description: the same grid without the convergence test; the population the shipped per-row reference files were written on, used by the self-check

separated_set.description: same shapes, incidence extended to populate H_TE >= 6; no unconverged rows

evaluation_note: The 59 rows the convergence test removes carry no XFOIL surface solution at all, so surface metrics cannot be formed on them; the filter is a property of the truth label and is applied identically to every model compared. Scores are never compared across the two sets.

inference_cost.shape gradients: 2.34x a sheet forward pass for dCl_gamma, 3.13x (dCl) and 3.12x (dCd) the coefficient chain, verified against central finite differences

limits: fixed discretization: the sheet is read on 241 nodes and the boundary layer on 121 nodes per surface; no resolution independence is claimed
the surface branch is trained and evaluated against XFOIL, not against RANS
both closures are empirical fits over their training range and are validated only on the two evaluation sets
the model is behind NeuralFoil's extra-large model on all three coefficients on both sets; the only measured advantage is profile drag at negative incidence
a blunt trailing edge cannot be represented by the 16-parameter form

training range: incidence -10 to 18 deg and Reynolds number 5e4 to 1e7 (XFOIL, Ncrit 7, incompressible); the evaluation sets cover -4 to 12 deg and 2e5 to 3e6. predict() issues vortfoil.RangeWarning outside the training range, for a 16-parameter fit error above 0.5% chord or a trailing-edge gap above 1% chord, and flags those rows in result.info['outside_training_range']

the RANS coefficient correction is fitted on AirfRANS NACA 4/5-digit sections (k-omega SST, alpha -5 to 15 deg, Re 2e6 to 6e6) and tested on 107 non-NACA SST sections; outside that range it warns (vortfoil.RangeWarning)
citation: Rhie, S.-H., Kim, G., Lim, S., Lee, J. VortFoil: A Vortex-Panel-Informed Neural Operator for Steady Airfoil Flow Prediction.
attribution: The anti-derivative approximator and the NeuroFoil staged-operator base are Prof. Jeongsu Lee's; this package packages the VortFoil build of that line.
